title: Identifying ultra-processed foods
text:
This is a helpful piece on ultra processed foods. How best to identify them from the package?  Not easy to tell with current labeling, hoping it will change. In the meanwhile, try the 10 to 1 test (1 gram fiber for every 10 grams of carbs) and the water test!  Easy peasy.
